outcome: diagnostic indices of NAMPT to reveal IAI
cohort: The study included three independent cohorts of women with singleton pregnancies complicated by preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM).
finding: Women with intra-amniotic infection and sterile intra-amniotic inflammation had significantly higher NAMPT levels in amniotic fluid compared to those with colonization or without microbial invasion and inflammation, while cervical fluid and maternal serum NAMPT levels did not reflect these complications.
cross-section timing: Between 24+0 and 36+6 weeks of gestation in women diagnosed with PPROM
